summary: The Form 6-K filed by Satellos Bioscience Inc. on June 17, 2026, reports the results of its Annual Meeting of Shareholders. The meeting elected directors and re-appointed auditors as detailed in the management information circular. Voting results show all director nominees elected with high percentages, though two directors received notable votes against (Stephanie Brown at 7.78% and Iris Loew-Friedrich at 16.24%). Only 55.3% of outstanding shares were represented. This is a routine corporate governance event with no special-situation transaction such as an acquisition, tender offer, or restructuring. There are no deal terms, strategic review, or activist campaign evident.
